<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 276.0666, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈275.0593 Da. By searching integer combinations of C, H, O and one N that match this exact mass, the formula C₁₇H₉NO₃ yields a calculated monoisotopic mass of 275.0582 Da, within 1 mDa of the observed value, making it the best fit. Hence the molecular formula of the sample is C17H9NO3.</thought>
<final_answer>C17H9NO3</final_answer>
